sql_templates.description: Fetch insider alerts and bulk/block deals for watchlist creation.
sql_templates.template:
SELECT ia.symbol, ia.entity, ia.alert_date, bd.deal_date, bd.qty, ss.technical_score
FROM signals.insider_alerts ia
JOIN signals.bulk_block_deals bd ON ia.symbol = bd.symbol
JOIN scores.stage_snapshots ss ON ia.symbol = ss.symbol
WHERE ia.alert_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '3 months'
AND bd.deal_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '3 months'
AND ss.snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM scores.stage_snapshots)
AND ss.technical_score > 0
LIMIT 100;

sql_templates.description: Fetch the latest quarterly metrics and analysis verdict for top companies.
sql_templates.template:
WITH latest_quarterly AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (qr.symbol) qr.symbol, qr.period_end, qr.revenue, qr.operating_profit, qr.opm_pct, qr.pat
  FROM scores.quarterly_results qr
  WHERE qr.period_type = 'quarter'
  ORDER BY qr.symbol, qr.period_end DESC NULLS LAST, qr.fetched_at DESC
),
latest_analysis AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (ra.symbol) ra.symbol, ra.verdict
  FROM scores.results_analysis ra
  ORDER BY ra.symbol, ra.period_end DESC NULLS LAST, ra.updated_at DESC
)
SELECT lq.symbol, lq.revenue, lq.operating_profit, lq.opm_pct, lq.pat, la.verdict
FROM latest_quarterly lq
JOIN latest_analysis la ON lq.symbol = la.symbol
JOIN scores.stage_snapshots ss ON lq.symbol = ss.symbol
WHERE ss.snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM scores.stage_snapshots)
LIMIT 10;

synthesis_guidance: Create a compelling narrative that leverages quantitative evidence alongside any qualitative insights available.
title: Quarterly Results Quality Review Variant 1153

validation_rules: Ensure data freshness and integrity according to evidence structure.
